paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: what the LORD says, He does. Jehu reminds Bidkar that the LORD had said, "so will I repay you on this plot of ground" (2 Kings 9:26). The LORD also said He saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons (2 Kings 9:26). This is a heavy passage, and I won't pretend it isn't.

Now look at how it closes. Jehu says of Jezebel, "This is the word of the LORD, which He spoke through His servant Elijah the Tishbite" (2 Kings 9:36). Joram's ending and Jezebel's ending both line up with words the LORD had already spoken (2 Kings 9:25-26, 36). What He said came true, and it landed right where He said it would.

So what does that mean for you? When you open your Bible, you can trust what it says, the promises AND the warnings. That's why I keep my ovens ready and my apron on, because I take Him at His word. But this story is NOT done, friend, so stay close.
